description: Book a 30-minute call with Lentra on cal.com in the person's name, at a time from find_call_slots. Only with the person's explicit go-ahead and their own name and email; cal.com emails them the invitation. An intro call (the default) also needs company, building_type and units; preferred_model is optional. An investor call (purpose investor) needs company (fund, family office or company), investor_type, stage, cheque_size and interest; ask the person, never guess. Attach configuration_id to send the hub along.

company.description: Company or property. Required for an intro call.

configuration_id.description: From configure_hub, to attach the configuration.

email.description: The person's email address, as they gave it. They will be emailed.

full_name.description: The person's full name, as they gave it.

interest.description: Investor call: what draws them to Lentra.

investor_type.description: Investor call: what kind of investor.

notes.description: What the person wants to discuss.

person_confirmed.description: true only if the person explicitly asked you to do this in their name, with these details. Never infer it.

preferred_model.description: Operating model the person prefers; not_sure if they haven't said.

stage.description: Investor call: stage they typically lead or follow at.

start.description: A time exactly as returned by find_call_slots.

time_zone.description: The person's IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Madrid.

units.description: Homes, rooms, beds or desks in the building. Required for an intro call.

name: book_call
title: Book a call
